title: Universal property of relative normalization
statement: Let $f:U\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes and let $U\xrightarrow{i}N\xrightarrow{n}S$ be its relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. If $a:U\to T$ and an integral morphism $q:T\to S$ satisfy $f=q\circ a$, there exists $d:N\to T$ with $d\circ i=a$ and $q\circ d=n$. Moreover, for any affine morphism $q:T\to S$, two morphisms $d_1,d_2:N\to T$ with $q\circ d_1=q\circ d_2=n$ and $d_1\circ i=d_2\circ i$ are equal.

proof.text: Use f.normalizationDesc a q H for the morphism. The two compatibility equations are toNormalization_normalizationDesc and normalizationDesc_comp. For two morphisms into an affine target, apply normalization.hom_ext with their common structural map and their equal restrictions. These are the three conclusions of the existing Mathlib universal property; no new proof obligation is introduced.
